messages.subject: [D-RUG]: Work group meeting tomorrow from 12-2
parts:
Hi Folks,

We will be having our final meeting of Winter quarter tomorrow from 12-2pm in 360 Shields Library. We will start meetings up again during the first week of Spring term at a TBD day and time. Come take a break from the beautiful weather (if only we could have meetings outside...) and bring your toughest R questions! We promise to try to help you solve them. 

Cheers,
Martha
